notes.title: DECK END IS NAHUAL
notes.content:
We just finished a major update is upon us for the game The End Is Nahual: If I may say so.

We finished the port for the STEAM DECK, got the certification, and implemented cross-platform cloud saves, but it's still not the native Linux port; I'm also working on it, which shall be done later next month.

Fixed multiple UI glitches that happened when you changed the aspect ratio of the game from 16x9 to 16x10.

Fixed multiple full-screen images to accommodate the new aspect ratio of 16x10.

Fixed camera size to accommodate the change in aspect ratio, depending on the level.

We added full support for the aspect ratio of 16x10. 

Multiple bug fixes and code optimizations were implemented.
It runs really well on steam deck you can get 95% of the time 60 fps on 5 Watts… it’s insane...

notes.title: Some big changes coming up and update 140 is up and AMA.
notes.content:
-Fixed a glitch while changing scenes in which the game will freeze if the CPU or GPU was at max.
-Added support for 16x10 aspect ratio, it's not fully implemented but the majority is there.
-Ui fixes everywhere... changing from 16x9 to 16x10 was a mess.

and we were primarily working on some other things... which are secret and you'll never get away from me...
